description: Finds drone platforms, components and software by model, product or category text across the DCMA Blue UAS Cleared List and Framework, FCC UAS Conditional Approvals and FAA Remote ID Declarations of Compliance in the MORVS Drone Register. Returns each matching designation with the company, list, action, date and source record, plus the current FCC Covered List exemption context taken from the register's reference records. An FAA declaration is the manufacturer's own statement, not an approval.

limit.description: Maximum matching designations to return; default 25, max 100.

list.description: Restrict to one list: dcma_blue_cleared, dcma_blue_framework, fcc_conditional_approval or faa_rid_doc; omit to search all four.

q.description: Model, product, component or category text, e.g. Mavic 3 Pro, X10D or flight controller; at least 2 characters.

name: drone_product_lookup
title: Find Drone Register Products
